name: Minamoto no Tōru
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 14); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 949.

poems.title: Ah! why does love distract my thoughts
poems.author: Minamoto no Tōru
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 14
poems.text:
Ah! why does love distract my thoughts,
Disordering my will!
I’m like the pattern on the cloth
Of Michinoku hill,—
All in confusion still.
